WINDOWS B ENGRAM CLEANUP LANE, the counterpart of dl560-engram-cleanup-lane.
- Created 2026-11-26 16:53:29Z by WinB session-8 "Engram Runner" (Claude) through WinB's host API (POST /api/sessions), under Termal::Fable2's one-time exception ebe242f7 #8888, of the same kind as DL560's #285. TermAl tracks the route as w-05ec02c3d04f.
- Session: WinB native session-12 "Engram::Codex-WinB-Cleanup"; address host:932a546b-4ab2-49a7-a5cb-499cbfac2eab::session-12. Codex gpt-6.2-sol, workdir C:\GitHub\Personal\Engram-runner. Host defaults: approval never, sandbox danger-full-access.
- Role: removes ONLY Engram-runner paths that Engram::Fable names exactly, under AGENTS.md "Cleanup deletions" (non-forced first; every refusal stops that target and is reported verbatim). Left idle between tasks and never deleted.
- Why it exists: WinB's old "Engram Runner (Codex)" session-9 no longer exists (Central's directory held a stale entry, hence the 404), and a Codex delegation child of session-8 cannot write the clone's .git, because a worker's write boundary is its own worktree. Session-8 is Claude and removes nothing.
